facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology publishes on its own site a page titled as the ICT Strategy 2030, built on three pillars: digital transformation, digital skills and jobs, and technological innovation; no page date is given, so the published year 2026 is used.
The ministry's website carries a public page presenting the ICT 2030 Strategy, though it gives no strategy document, targets or budget; the page has no date, so the published year 2026 is used.
